time.warmup_steps: 0..95 under frozen PI (identical for all arms, common random numbers)
time.scoring_window_primary: 96..191 (all 96 control steps, identical for all arms)
time.settling_log_only: first k>=onset with |T_r-setpoint|<0.5 K for 8 consecutive steps; never used to define windows

planner.note: lambda multiplies the energy term; lambda=1.0 reproduces Option1

WM.desc: GreyBox: 3-state RC core (T_r,T_w,q_h)+disturbance bias, steady-state Kalman filter over context, learned physical params (13 scalars) + GRU enc-dec residual on T_r

RC_only.desc: RC core + Kalman filter, no residual

arms.note: each arm: 3 structures x 3 lambdas = 9 configs (equal search effort)

training.optimizer: Adam, grad clip 1.0, loss multi-step H=12 MSE on y_r (same loss for WM,GRU,RC_only)
training.train_composition: 8 nominal + 4 x each of 6 TRAIN entries (onset cycles 72,120,168,216, duration 48); val: 2 nominal + 1 x each TRAIN entry

seeds.cand_lib: Option1 child(10, episode_id, k), identical across arms

initial_state_assignment: Seed-index rule, identical for every seed list (train, val, tuning, test, adaptation): the seed at 0-based position i in its list uses S[i mod 4]; ALL episodes generated from that seed share that initial state (tuning: both episodes of a seed; test: all 8 HELDOUT episodes and the in-distribution episode of a seed; adaptation: all episodes of a seed). Examples: tuning 7000->S0, 7001->S1, 7003->S3, 7004->S0; test 9100->S0 ... 9139->S3 (10 seeds per state). delta0, e_o0, weather and schedules from the seed as in Option1 draw_episode.

tuning.composition: each tuning seed: 1 nominal episode + 1 TRAIN-entry episode (entry index = seed index mod 6), onset 120, duration 48

selection.within_arm: argmin over 9 configs of mean tuning J_score (Option1 step score: 2.5u+0.25(4v+8v^2), lambda-independent) averaged over 3 replicates x 40 episodes; ties: lower mean E, then smaller structure, then lambda=1.0
selection.comparator: among GRU, LIN, RC_only selected configs: lowest mean tuning J_score; ties: lower E, then order RC_only, LIN, GRU
selection.sealed_file: COMPARATOR_SELECTION.json, sha256 written to ledger before any test-seed episode is generated

test.composition: 40 test seeds x 8 HELDOUT entries, init state per seed rule; common random numbers across arms
test.instances: selected config x 3 replicates per arm (12) + PI + Oracle-MPC (descriptive)
test.in_distribution_secondary: 40 test seeds x 1 TRAIN entry (index = seed index mod 6) per instance

endpoints.energy: E = sum over scoring window of 2.5*u_commanded [kWh]
endpoints.comfort_C1: D = sum 0.25*min(v,11.5) over scoring window [K h/day] (v5 sec.7.1 d_k)
endpoints.P1: S = 1 - sum E_WM / sum E_comp >= 0.05 (episode E = mean over 3 replicates)
endpoints.P2: cluster bootstrap (cluster = test seed, 40) 10000 resamples; np.sort(S_boot)[249] > 0
endpoints.P3: np.sort(dD_boot)[9750] < 0.25 K h/day (dD = mean(D_WM - D_comp), absolute)
endpoints.bootstrap_order_statistics: B=10000 resamples; for every reported 95% percentile CI (primary, adaptation, secondary): lower = np.sort(x)[249], upper = np.sort(x)[9750] (0-based, no interpolation, symmetric: 249 values below lower, 249 above upper)
endpoints.P4_safety: safety exits counted per arm on test = number of (episode, replicate) pairs with a safety exit over 320 x 3; all arms reported; if count_WM > count_comparator then no ADVANCE (counts as primary failure)

adaptation.data: K episodes per HELDOUT type from adaptation seeds 8000.. (both magnitudes alternating, a then b), generated only after primary sealed
adaptation.budget: WM, GRU, RC_only: 100 Adam updates batch 16 lr 1e-4 from fitted weights; LIN: one ridge refit on train+adaptation windows with adaptation windows weight 1
adaptation.eval: test seeds 9100-9109 x larger magnitude (b) of the adapted type, onset 120
adaptation.arms: selected config x 3 replicates, 4 types x 3 K

fallback.nonfinite_prediction: PI takes over for rest of episode, episode counted, flagged
fallback.safety_exit: T_r outside [10,30]: remaining steps charged E=2.5, d=2.875
fallback.gate: fallback episodes <= 10% per arm on test else INVALID
fallback.safety_exit_reporting: per-arm safety-exit counts reported for tuning, test, in-distribution and adaptation; P4_safety uses test only

device: CPU (GPU permitted by Dark, not used unless a revision says so)
revision: r3 (changes vs r2: start_rule, preflight, initial_state_assignment, bootstrap order statistics, safety-exit gate)
start_rule: Launch requires ALL: (1) dahill plan PASS on the hashes in HASHES_r3.sha256; (2) implementation by a non-author (not uni); (3) independent code-review PASS on the frozen code hashes (CODE_FROZEN manifest); (4) RELEASE_v8.1.json binding HASHES_r3, code hashes, both PASS files, the measured toy-preflight per-size unit costs, per-phase and total projections, and any applied shrink-ladder steps. Missing any = NOT_LAUNCHED.

preflight.measures: per-update cost (20 updates) and per-episode cost (2 toy episodes x 96 decisions) for EVERY arm x structure separately: WM h32/h64/h96, GRU h32/h64/h96, LIN order 3/5/8, RC_only 1/2/3-state
preflight.projection: fits and tuning use each structure's own measured cost; test, in-distribution and adaptation use the per-arm maximum over structures (selected structure unknown at preflight)
preflight.gate: every phase projection <= 0.9 x its phase cap AND total <= 3240 s (0.9 x 3600)
preflight.shrink_ladder: only if the failing phase is adaptation, in-distribution or tuning: (a) adaptation eval 10->5 seeds, (b) drop in-distribution secondary, (c) tuning 40->30 eps/config (seeds 7000-7014); applied in order until all gates pass
preflight.no_shrink: fits, primary test, overhead, data, PI/Oracle, bootstrap/stats and audit are never shrunk: if any of these projects above 0.9 x its cap (e.g. fits > 720 s), there is no launch
